scripts.build: bun run --filter platform-app build && bun run --filter platform-api build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,app -c blue,green "bun run --filter platform-api dev" "bun run --filter platform-app dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/platform-api --noEmit && tsc -p apps/platform-app --noEmit
scripts.test: bun test --filter platform-api && bun run --filter @ae-hq/shared test
